objective: Document how the holyagent plugin is installed by this project and picks up new content by itself, and how to clear the duplicate copy the Claude desktop app lists.
scope: Worktree /home/davidbasile/dev/holyagent-docs-desktop-plugin-install (branch release/0.1.2/docs/desktop-plugin-install, stacked on the Exa branch 09a40ec); ownership paths relative to it.

Established facts (cite them as findings, not guesses): (1) .claude/settings.json declares the directory marketplace holyagent at path . and enables holyagent@holyagent; Claude Code in WSL installs it at project scope on first open. (2) A directory-marketplace plugin is read from its source folder at every session start: claude plugin list prints Read from <source> and the session init path is the source, so a rebuilt plugin (mise run build) loads in the next session or after /reload-plugins with no update command; the cache copy and installed_plugins.json record go stale and do not matter; claude plugin update only rewrites them when the version changes. (3) The Claude desktop app lists plugins from its own account store (AppData/Roaming/Claude/rpm), where holyagent appears as a user-added marketplace plugin (installedBy user) with a full copy of 0.1.1-2; that store never shows the WSL project install (Neste projeto: 0), so the desktop list is not evidence of what a Code-tab session on this WSL checkout loads. (4) To remove the duplicate, uninstall or remove the user-added holyagent marketplace from the desktop app Settings > Plugins; the project install keeps working.

Update docs/usage.md (install and update sections) and docs/development.md if it describes updating, plus AGENTS.md only if a line there contradicts these facts (AGENTS.md is a repository pitfall list; keep its style). English, repository style.
constraints: User (verbatim): Tirar a instalação duplicada de projeto, fazer o Desktop instalar o plugin pelo próprio projeto e atualizá-lo sozinho quando o conteúdo mudar.

User clarified earlier: holyagent is installed on the user own PC from this local checkout (directory marketplace); no GitHub marketplace and no change to the repository .claude/settings.json is wanted.
No version-control writes and no edits under .holyagent or the repository metadata folder. Report the changed paths.
Done means mise run verify passes in the worktree.

No doc still tells the user to run plugin update commands to pick up new content.
